descriptions.close_window: close the current or named window
descriptions.switch_workspace: switch to a numbered workspace or desktop
descriptions.play_pause: play, pause, resume or stop media
descriptions.none: not a command for the computer (talking to a person, thinking aloud, reading)
descriptions.set_time: set the clock to a given time
descriptions.press: click a link, button, tab or fold-out that is on screen
descriptions.toggle_strawberry: open or close the STRAWBERRY fold-out
descriptions.show_commands: open or close the list of commands
descriptions.show_examples: open or close the example chips
